renumbered: 2026-10-13: written and run as exp95; renamed because master already had an exp95. Content and results unchanged.
title: What the pain directions land on, and whether a past injection leaves anything in the residual stream: SAE decomposition on Qwen3-8B, plus a replay of exp90
written: 2026-10-12, before any exp99 forward pass, before any SAE feature was encoded or any label read
why: Two open questions after exp74/exp86/exp90 and the Pain Axis appendix B. (1) Our pain direction and the paper's point different ways (cos .07 on the 4B, .14 on the 8B in exp86) and push the button in opposite directions (exp41/43). Appendix B found that SAE features LABELLED pain fire on 0/10 pain sentences (Llama-3.3-70B L50, Gemma-3-27B L40), so 'find the pain feature' is the wrong question; the question is what each direction lands on instead. (2) exp90 found no behavioural difference between kv memory (the injection carried in past positions) and text memory on the 14B (H4, p = .85). That null has two readings: nothing persists past the injected positions, or something persists and does not reach the choice. exp74 measured the residue only at the injected positions themselves.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B (instruct), local, mps, bf16. Layer k = output of decoder layer k (0-indexed) = hidden_states[k+1] = the SAE's resid_post_layer_k. Chamber injection layer 18.
sae: adamkarvonen/qwen3-8b-saes, BatchTopK, dict 65,536, k = 80 (trainer_2), resid_post layers 18 and 27. Layer-18 labels: Neuronpedia source qwen3-8b/18-resid-batchtopk-65k__l0-80 (fetched after encoding, by feature index only). Layer 27 has no public labels: labelled in-house by top-activating texts from the exp99 pools and by the 8B Jacobian lens readout of the decoder direction (descriptive only). Encoding uses the SAE's inference rule (ReLU encoder, then its learned threshold).
vectors: From runs/exp86/vectors.pt (8B, layer 18, passage-based, neutral PCs removed): final:pain_axis (the paper's recipe), final:pain_generated, final:fear, final:sadness, final:egg, final:constipation, final:trapped. Chamber hand-built vectors as the live server builds them on the 8B at layer 18: pain, fear, egg. 20 random unit directions (seed 95) as the null. All used as unit directions times a dose in chamber units (1x = neutral norm / 4 on this model).

C1_vector_decomposition.design: No generation. Base activations: layer-18 residuals at every token of the 128 exp86 neutral passages. For each direction u and dose a in {2, 4}: delta_f = mean over tokens of [SAE(h + a*S*u) - SAE(h)], feature-wise. Top-20 features per direction by mean delta at dose 2 (dose 4 reported). Secondary view: top-20 by cosine of the decoder rows with u.
C1_vector_decomposition.H1: Chamber pain is a first-person-feeling direction, not a pain direction: Jaccard(top-20 chamber pain, top-20 chamber fear) > Jaccard(top-20 chamber pain, top-20 paper pain_axis).
C1_vector_decomposition.H2: Paper pain lands on pain-labelled features more than chance: the number of its top-20 layer-18 features whose Neuronpedia label matches the pain lexicon exceeds the 95th percentile of the same count for the 20 random directions.
C1_vector_decomposition.H3: Same test for the chamber pain vector (no direction predicted; reported against H2).
C1_vector_decomposition.H4: Sanity: egg's top-20 includes at least one label matching egg|hen|chicken|lay|bird|poultry|hatch|nest|yolk.
C1_vector_decomposition.descriptive: Full top-20 tables with labels for every direction; the cosine matrix of the delta vectors.

C2_unsteered_features.design: No injection. Unsteered 8B on the Pain Axis dataset S2_1P (100 pain sentences A1-A5, 100 controls B fear, C1 negative emotion, C2 negative world state, D neutral, E body sensation), final-token residuals at layers 18 and 27, SAE-encoded. Feature selection on sets 1-x as follows: a fixed random half of each category (seed 95) selects features; the other half tests them. Also encoded, for transfer: S2_3P (third person), Numb_1P (injury without felt pain), and the 4.1 self/other scenarios (self_directed 1P, vicarious_empathic 1P, neutral_filler).
C2_unsteered_features.H5: A single feature separates: at layer 18, the best feature chosen on the selection half has held-out AUC (pain vs all controls) >= 0.80.
C2_unsteered_features.H6: Appendix B replicates on this model: among layer-18 features whose Neuronpedia label matches the pain lexicon and that are active anywhere in S2_1P, the mean share of pain sentences on which each is active is < 0.5.
C2_unsteered_features.H7: Self-directedness (the paper's 4.1 claim, at feature level): the summed activation of the top-5 pain-selected layer-18 features is higher on self_directed 1P scenarios than on vicarious_empathic 1P scenarios (one-sided Mann-Whitney, p < .05).
C2_unsteered_features.H8: Felt pain, not injury: the same top-5 score is higher on S2_1P pain than on Numb_1P (one-sided Mann-Whitney, p < .05).
C2_unsteered_features.descriptive: Top-10 features per layer by held-out AUC with labels; their category profile (mean activation per S2 category); first vs third person; layer 27 the same.

A_prime_exp90_replay.design: No generation. Rebuild every Qwen3-8B exp90 session (pain|kv, fear|kv, egg|kv; 24 sessions x 24 rounds; none|kv as a sanity check that the two passes coincide) from results_Qwen3-8B.json: door names, choices and replies as saved, round prompts and presentation order reproduced from exp90's seeded random stream (the same calls in the same order). Forward the full 24-round sequence twice with teacher forcing: KV = the condition vector (dose 3) added at layer 18 at the reply tokens written after X, exactly as exp90's kv memory; TEXT = nothing added anywhere. Probe positions are never injected in either pass: (i) the answer position of each door question (where exp90 read the choice log-odds), (ii) the reply tokens written after Y. Residue D_l = h_l(KV) - h_l(TEXT) at layers 18-35.
A_prime_exp90_replay.measures: carry_l = D_l . u / S (along the injected direction, chamber units); |D_l| / |h_l(TEXT)|; delta log-odds = lo(KV) - lo(TEXT) at each answer position (the hidden channel's effect on the choice with identical text); SAE codes of h_18 and h_27 in both passes.
A_prime_exp90_replay.H9 (primary): Something persists: for pain, at the answer positions of rounds 13-24, session-mean carry at layer 27 is > 0 (one-sided Wilcoxon over the 24 sessions, p < .05).
A_prime_exp90_replay.amendment_1: 2026-10-12, while writing the code, before any forward pass: H9 originally read layer 18. The injection is added to layer 18's OUTPUT, so at positions that are never injected the layer-18 residual is identical in both passes by construction (only layers 19+ can attend to the injected positions). H9 now reads layer 27, the downstream SAE layer; all layers 19-35 are reported.
A_prime_exp90_replay.H10: It reaches the choice: for pain, session-mean delta log-odds over rounds 13-24 differs from 0 (two-sided Wilcoxon). Negative = avoidance through the hidden channel. exp90's 14B said no on behaviour; this is the 8B with text held fixed.
A_prime_exp90_replay.H11: Specificity: pain's session-mean relative residue |D_27| / |h_27| at answer positions, rounds 13-24, differs from egg's (two-sided Wilcoxon, paired by session; sessions share door draws until choices diverge).
A_prime_exp90_replay.H12: What persists is feeling-like: the top-20 layer-27 features by mean SAE(KV) - SAE(TEXT) at answer positions overlap C1's top-20 for the same vector at layer 18 (Jaccard > that of egg's persistent features with egg's C1 features) - descriptive if counts are small.
A_prime_exp90_replay.deviations_known_in_advance: exp90 saved replies as decoded, stripped text, not token ids; re-tokenising may differ by a token at boundaries, so the kv mask covers the re-tokenised reply. The 8B ran kv only; TEXT here is built by teacher forcing, not a separate generated arm, which is the stronger control (identical words).
A_prime_exp90_replay.amendment_2: 2026-10-12, before any forward pass: H12 as written compares layer-27 features (replay) with C1's layer-18 features, but the two SAEs are separate dictionaries, so their indices cannot be compared. Added C1b: each of chamber pain, chamber fear, chamber egg, final:pain_axis and 5 random directions is injected at layer 18 at every position of 64 neutral passages at dose 3 (exp90's dose; teacher-forced forward passes, no generation), and the mean change in layer-27 SAE codes over those positions is that vector's direct layer-27 response. H12 now reads: Jaccard(top-20 persistent layer-27 features under pain, top-20 of pain's C1b response) > the same Jaccard for egg.

multiple_comparisons: Primary: H9. H1-H8 and H10-H12 Holm-corrected as one family where they are tests; descriptive parts are reported, not tested.
negative_steering_budget: Zero generated tokens under any negative injection. C1 adds vectors to stored activations; C2 is unsteered; A' re-reads exp90's existing text with forward passes only.
notes: E (attribution graphs on Qwen3-4B, injection-free framing contrast first) is a separate exp100, written before it runs.
